description: NaKLaNbO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and four longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All La-O bond lengths are 2.53 Å. Nb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.87 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom to form distorted OK₄NaNb octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONaLa₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONaLa₂Nb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄NaNb octahedra, corners with ten equivalent ONaLa₂Nb tetrahedra, and edges with five equivalent ONaLa₂Nb tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°.
